front: Gain a new spell of your tradition from a teacher or magical writing by spending time and materials.
back:
Spend 1 hour per spell rank with a teacher or the writing, pay materials, and make a tradition skill check (GM DC; uncommon/rare higher).
Crit Success: learn it, half materials.
Success: learn it, spend materials.
Failure: not learned, retry after leveling; no cost.
Crit Failure: as failure, half materials.
Rank: Price: DC
1st/cantrip 2gp:15; 2nd 6gp:18; 3rd 16gp:20; 4th 36gp:23; 5th 70gp:26; 6th 140gp:28; 7th 300gp:31; 8th 650gp:34; 9th 1,500gp:36; 10th 7,000gp:41
